channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Can Starmer survive Mandelson scandal?
item.description: We are joined by senior political correspondent Paul McNamara in Westminster.

item.title: Mandelson: Is it time for Starmer to go? Labour MPs debate
item.description: We were joined by Labour MPs Clive Efford, who recently helped re-launch the tribune group of soft-left MPs, and John McDonnell, who was Shadow Chancellor under the leadership of Jeremy Corbyn.

item.title: ‘Shameful day for government and parliament’ – security committee chair
item.description: We were joined by Lord Beamish, a Labour peer and chair of the Intelligence and Security Committee of Parliament, which now has a key role in the release of material related to Peter Mandelson.

item.title: Palestine Action activists cleared of burglary charges
item.description: Six Palestine Action activists have been cleared of aggravated burglary in connection with a break-in at the Bristol site of Israeli defence firm Elbit Systems.

item.title: Police investigate claims Epstein trafficked woman to UK for Andrew
item.description: Jeffrey Epstein's connections with this country extended far beyond Lord Mandelson or Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor.

item.title: Cluster bomb market attack kills seven in Ukraine as Russian peace talks begin
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said the trilateral talks with Russia and the United States which resumed again Wednesday in Abu Dhabi must lead to real peace and not give Russia an opportunity to continue the war.

item.title: Interview with Russian ambassador to UK – What does Putin want out of peace talks with Ukraine?
item.description: We spoke to the Russian ambassador to the UK, Andrei Kelin.

item.title: Falsified welfare checks led to deaths of vulnerable inmates, inquest told
item.description: A coroner is to refer all five self-inflicted deaths within nine months at a prison in Nottinghamshire to police, for investigation into possible misconduct in public office.

item.title: Starmer acting with ‘moral clarity’ and ‘urgency’ over Mandelson crisis – health minister
item.description: The government is pledging to combat cancer and promises that three quarters of people in England will survive by 2035. We spoke to health minister Zubir Ahmed.

item.title: Son of former Libyan ruler Gaddafi killed
item.description: Libyan officials say they're investigating the death of Saif al Islam Gaddafi, the son of the country's late dictator Muammar Gaddafi, and said they were searching for suspects.
